net.guizhanss.gcereborn.items

Class GCEItems

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.guizhanss.gcereborn.items.GCEItems

  • public final class GCEItems
extends java.lang.Object
    Static Slimefun items of this addon.

    Names and lore are no longer baked in Java: every item is constructed name-less (id + material/head) and its display name plus the Type/Description/Stats/Usage lore blocks are authored per language in languages/<lang>/items.yml, resolved at runtime by the fork's ItemTranslationService (wired via registerTranslations in the main class). This replaces the deprecated machine/power lore-builder calls and the addon's own getLocalization().getItem(...) name lookup.
